house_rules: No sexual content. Canon scenes that contain it are cut or replaced, keeping only the plot consequence (threat stays at lethality, fear or control).
Follow the novel's canon chapter by chapter unless the player's choice changes it; record the next canon chapter after each scene.
The player decides for Eyoel. End on a pending decision and never resolve it for them.
Every realm breakthrough needs a cause on the page: a resource, an inheritance, a baptism or a fight.
